```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidypopgen)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r set-directories, include=FALSE}
res_dir <- "../results/s04_full_pca/"
```

# Load gt

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <-
  gt_load("../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean_ld.gt")
```

# Loci and sample count

```{r}
nrow(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
count_loci(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
```

# Count individuals from each group 

```{r}
malagasy_data <- subset(
  mad_bor_g1000_sum,
  mad_bor_g1000_sum$population %in% c(
    "Mikea", "Vezo",

    "Merina",
    "Betsimisaraka",

nrow(malagasy_data)
```

# Impute

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- gt_impute_simple(mad_bor_g1000_sum, method = "mean")
gt_set_imputed(mad_bor_g1000_sum, TRUE)
gt_save(
  mad_bor_g1000_sum,
  "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_neo_clean_ld_imputed.gt"
)
```

# Compute PCA

```{r}
random_pca <- gt_pca_autoSVD(mad_bor_g1000_sum)
pcs <- as.data.frame(random_pca$u)
variance <- tidy(random_pca)
```

# Add population metadata

```{r}
pop_names <-
  read.csv("../data/raw/data_input/igsr-1000-genomes-phase-3-release.tsv",
    sep = "\t"
  )

# find matching id in pop_names Sample.name and mad_bor_g1000_sum id
# for the matches, replace the population with the population in pop_names
for (i in seq_len(nrow(pop_names))) {
  if (pop_names$Sample.name[i] %in% mad_bor_g1000_sum$id) {
    mad_bor_g1000_sum[mad_bor_g1000_sum$id == pop_names$Sample.name[i], "population"] <- pop_names$Population.name[i]
  }
}

# replace "Luhya,Luhya" with "Luhya"
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  mutate(population = case_when(
    population == "Luhya,Luhya" ~ "Luhya",
    population == "Esan,Esan" ~ "Esan",
    population == "Gambian Mandinka,Gambian" ~ "Gambian Mandinka",
    population == "Mende,Mende" ~ "Mende",
    population == "Kinh,Kinh Vietnamese" ~ "Kinh Vietnamese",
    population == "Punjabi,Punjabi" ~ "Punjabi",
    population == "Bengali,Bengali" ~ "Bengali",
    TRUE ~ population
  ))


# replace any _ with a space
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  mutate(population = gsub("_", " ", population))
```

# Plot PCA

```{r}
# create a new factor column with Malagasy populations as 1 and others as 0
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  mutate(malagasy = 0)

# rename "Sakalava Tsimihety" and "Diego"
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  mutate(population = case_when(
    population == "Sakalava Tsimihety" ~ "Sakalava/Tsimihety",
    population == "Diego" ~ "Diego Mixed",
    TRUE ~ population
  ))

all_malagasy <- subset(
  mad_bor_g1000_sum,
  population %in% c(
    "Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego Mixed",
    "Sakalava/Tsimihety", "Betsileo",
    "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro"
  )
)

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  mutate(malagasy = ifelse(id %in% all_malagasy$id, 1, 0))

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  mutate(Region = "Other")
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  mutate(Region = case_when(
    population %in% c("Borneo", "Sumba", "Timor") ~ "Island southeast Asia",
    population %in% c("Bengali", "Punjabi") ~ "South Asia",
    population %in% c("Southern Han Chinese", "Kinh Vietnamese") ~ "East Asia",
    population %in% c(
      "Esan",
      "Gambian Mandinka",
      "Luhya",
      "Mende",
      "Yoruba"
    ) ~ "Africa",
    malagasy == 1 ~ population,
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  mutate(Region = case_when(
    Region == "Other" ~ "Africa",
    TRUE ~ Region
  ))


ggplot(pcs, aes(x = V1, y = V2, colour = mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = paste0("PC 1 (", round(variance$percent[1], 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC 2 (", round(variance$percent[2], 2), "%)"),
    colour = "Population"
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(ncol = 2, byrow = TRUE, size = 2)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.text = element_text(size = 5),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white")
  )
```

This PCA uses the KING relatedness filtering of 0.088, equivalent to second degree relatives, filtered within each population. 

Unbalanced sample sizes will cause bias in the dimensions of this first plot. To explore how this might be affecting the PCA, the next dataset will randomly subsample populations with more individuals down to equivalent sizes.

# Create a dataset with broadly equal sample sizes

```{r}
set.seed(1)

subsample <- function(x) {
  if (nrow(x) <= 30) {
    return(x$id)
  } else {
    x <- sample_n(x, size = 30)
    return(x$id)
  }
}

keep <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  group_by(population) %>%
  group_map(~ {
    if (!(.y$population %in% c(
      "Betsimisaraka", "Merina", "Diego Mixed",
      "Sakalava/Tsimihety", "Betsileo",
      "Vezo", "Mikea", "Temoro"
    ))) {
      subsample(.x)
    } else {
      .x$id
    }
  })

mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>% filter(id %in% unlist(keep))

gt <-
  "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_clean_neo_ld_subsampled.gt"

if (file.exists(gt)) {
  file.remove(gt)
}
gt_save(
  mad_bor_g1000_sum,
  "../data/intermediate/rbind_data/mad_bor_g1000_sum_clean_neo_ld_subsampled.gt"
)
```

# Plot PCA

```{r}
# create a new factor column with Malagasy populations as 1 and others as 0
mad_bor_g1000_sum$mad_vs_global <- "Other"

fill <- function(x) {
  if (x["malagasy"] == 1) {
    x["mad_vs_global"] <- "Malagasy"
  } else {
    x["mad_vs_global"] <- x["population"]
  }
}

mad_bor_g1000_sum$mad_vs_global <- apply(mad_bor_g1000_sum, 1, FUN = fill)
```

```{r}
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  mutate(Region = "Other")
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  mutate(Region = case_when(
    population %in% c("Borneo", "Sumba", "Timor") ~ "Island southeast Asia",
    population %in% c("Bengali", "Punjabi") ~ "South Asia",
    population %in% c("Southern Han Chinese", "Kinh Vietnamese") ~ "East Asia",
    population %in% c(
      "Esan",
      "Gambian Mandinka",
      "Luhya",
      "Mende",
      "Yoruba"
    ) ~ "Africa",
    malagasy == 1 ~ population,
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  ))
mad_bor_g1000_sum <- mad_bor_g1000_sum %>%
  mutate(Region = case_when(
    Region == "Other" ~ "Africa",
    TRUE ~ Region
  ))

plt <- ggplot(pcs, aes(
  x = V1, y = V2,
  colour = mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region,
  shape = as.factor(mad_bor_g1000_sum$malagasy)
)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = paste0("PC 1 (", round(variance$percent[1], 2), "%)"),

    shape = "none"

    plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
```

```{r}
mad_pops <- c("Betsileo", "Betsimisaraka", "Diego Mixed", "Merina",
              "Mikea", "Sakalava/Tsimihety", "Temoro", "Vezo")
ref_regions <- c("Africa", "East Asia", "South Asia", "Island southeast Asia")

# One tidy data frame; factor levels set the legend order (references first)
plot_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pcs$V1,
  PC2 = pcs$V2,
  Region = factor(mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region, levels = c(ref_regions, mad_pops))
)
plot_df$is_mad <- plot_df$Region %in% mad_pops

# Single palette / shape vector keyed by Region, so one legend covers everything
pal <- c(
  "Africa"                = "#8B1A2B",  # black: darkest, no Dark2 colour is this dark
  "East Asia"             = "#0072B2",  # strong mid-blue (Okabe-Ito)
  "South Asia"            = "#000000",  # light sky blue (Okabe-Ito)
  "Island southeast Asia" = "#56B4E9",   # deep wine/maroon
  # Malagasy: your original colourblind-friendly Dark2 colours
  "Betsileo"              = "#1B9E77",
  "Betsimisaraka"         = "#D95F02",
  "Diego Mixed"           = "#7570B3",
  "Merina"                = "#E7298A",
  "Mikea"                 = "#66A61E",
  "Sakalava/Tsimihety"    = "#E6AB02",
  "Temoro"                = "#A6761D",
  "Vezo"                  = "#666666"
)

shp <- c(
  # references: open shapes only
  "Africa" = 0, "East Asia" = 1, "South Asia" = 2, "Island southeast Asia" = 5,
  # Malagasy: solid / line-based shapes only (no hollow ones)
  "Betsileo" = 16, "Betsimisaraka" = 3, "Diego Mixed" = 4, "Merina" = 15,
  "Mikea" = 17, "Sakalava/Tsimihety" = 8, "Temoro" = 25, "Vezo" = 18
)

ggplot(mapping = aes(x = PC1, y = PC2,
                     colour = Region, fill = Region, shape = Region)) +
  # Bottom layer: references, open shapes, low alpha, slightly smaller
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_df, !is_mad),
             alpha = 0.3, size = 1.5, stroke = 0.5) +
  # Top layer: Malagasy populations, solid shapes, higher alpha
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_df, is_mad),
             alpha = 0.8, size = 2.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +      # only affects shape 25 (Temoro)
  scale_shape_manual(values = shp) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = paste0("PC 1 (", round(variance$percent[1], 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC 2 (", round(variance$percent[2], 2), "%)"),
    colour = NULL, fill = NULL, shape = NULL   # identical titles => one merged legend
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 2.5))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.position = c(0.15, 0.37)
  )
```

```{r}
mad_pops <- c("Betsileo", "Betsimisaraka", "Diego Mixed", "Merina",
              "Mikea", "Sakalava/Tsimihety", "Temoro", "Vezo")
ref_regions <- c("Africa", "East Asia", "South Asia", "Island southeast Asia")

# One tidy data frame; factor levels set the legend order (references first)
plot_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pcs$V1,
  PC2 = pcs$V2,
  Region = factor(mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region, levels = c(ref_regions, mad_pops))
)
plot_df$is_mad <- plot_df$Region %in% mad_pops

# Single palette / shape vector keyed by Region, so one legend covers everything
pal <- c(
  "Africa"                = "grey",
  "East Asia"             = "grey",
  "South Asia"            = "grey",
  "Island southeast Asia" = "grey",
  # Malagasy: your original colourblind-friendly Dark2 colours
  "Betsileo"              = "#1B9E77",
  "Betsimisaraka"         = "#D95F02",
  "Diego Mixed"           = "#7570B3",
  "Merina"                = "#E7298A",
  "Mikea"                 = "#66A61E",
  "Sakalava/Tsimihety"    = "#E6AB02",
  "Temoro"                = "#A6761D",
  "Vezo"                  = "#666666"
)

shp <- c(
  # references: open shapes only
  "Africa" = 0, "East Asia" = 1, "South Asia" = 2, "Island southeast Asia" = 5,
  # Malagasy: solid / line-based shapes only (no hollow ones)
  "Betsileo" = 16, "Betsimisaraka" = 3, "Diego Mixed" = 4, "Merina" = 15,
  "Mikea" = 17, "Sakalava/Tsimihety" = 8, "Temoro" = 25, "Vezo" = 18
)

ggplot(mapping = aes(x = PC1, y = PC2,
                     colour = Region, fill = Region, shape = Region)) +
  # Bottom layer: references, open shapes, low alpha, slightly smaller
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_df, !is_mad),
             alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5, stroke = 0.5) +
  # Top layer: Malagasy populations, solid shapes, higher alpha
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_df, is_mad),
             alpha = 0.7, size = 2.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +      # only affects shape 25 (Temoro)
  scale_shape_manual(values = shp) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = paste0("PC 1 (", round(variance$percent[1], 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC 2 (", round(variance$percent[2], 2), "%)"),
    colour = NULL, fill = NULL, shape = NULL   # identical titles => one merged legend
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 2.5))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.position = c(0.15, 0.37)
  )
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

mad_pops <- c("Betsileo", "Betsimisaraka", "Diego Mixed", "Merina",
              "Mikea", "Sakalava/Tsimihety", "Temoro", "Vezo")
ref_regions <- c("Africa", "East Asia", "South Asia", "Island southeast Asia")

plot_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pcs$V1,
  PC2 = pcs$V2,
  Region = factor(mad_bor_g1000_sum$Region, levels = c(ref_regions, mad_pops))
)
plot_df$is_mad <- plot_df$Region %in% mad_pops

pal <- c(
  # references
  "Africa"                = "#000000",
  "East Asia"             = "#0072B2",
  "South Asia"            = "#56B4E9",
  "Island southeast Asia" = "#8B1A2B",
  # Malagasy (Dark2)
  "Betsileo"              = "#1B9E77",
  "Betsimisaraka"         = "#D95F02",
  "Diego Mixed"           = "#7570B3",
  "Merina"                = "#E7298A",
  "Mikea"                 = "#66A61E",
  "Sakalava/Tsimihety"    = "#E6AB02",
  "Temoro"                = "#A6761D",
  "Vezo"                  = "#666666"
)

shp <- c(
  "Africa" = 0, "East Asia" = 1, "South Asia" = 2, "Island southeast Asia" = 5,
  "Betsileo" = 16, "Betsimisaraka" = 3, "Diego Mixed" = 4, "Merina" = 15,
  "Mikea" = 17, "Sakalava/Tsimihety" = 8, "Temoro" = 25, "Vezo" = 18
)

ggplot(mapping = aes(x = PC1, y = PC2,
                     colour = Region, fill = Region, shape = Region)) +
  # 1. references: bottom layer
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_df, !is_mad),
             alpha = 0.4, size = 1.5, stroke = 0.6) +
  # 2. single ellipse around all Malagasy points
  stat_ellipse(data = subset(plot_df, is_mad),
               aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, group = 1),
               inherit.aes = FALSE,
               type = "norm", level = 0.9,
               colour = "grey25", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7,
               show.legend = FALSE) +
  # 3. Malagasy points on top
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_df, is_mad),
             alpha = 0.7, size = 2.2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pal) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = shp) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = paste0("PC 1 (", round(variance$percent[1], 2), "%)"),
    y = paste0("PC 2 (", round(variance$percent[2], 2), "%)"),
    colour = NULL, fill = NULL, shape = NULL
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(alpha = 1, size = 2.5))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16),
    axis.line = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.15, 0.37)
  )
```
